documents.title: March 24, 2026 NYCIDA Board Meeting Minutes
documents.text:
MINUTES OF THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF NEW YORK CITY INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AGENCY MARCH 24, 2026
5. Bogopa Jerome Inc.
Bogopa Jerome Inc. was presented for review and adoption of an inducement resolution for the project. There being no further questions, a motion to approve the resolution for Bogopa Jerome Inc. was made, seconded and unanimously approved.
6. MGN 24-53 49th Street, LLC & MGN 150 Liberty, LLC
The companies were presented for review and adoption for the project. There being no further questions, a motion to approve the resolutions was made, seconded and unanimously approved.
7. Outback 1, LLC & Sunnyside 1, LLC
The companies were presented for review and adoption for the project. There being no further questions, a motion to approve the resolutions was made, seconded and unanimously approved.
8. Adjournment
PROJECT NUMBER - 11268 FRESH PROGRAM PROPOSAL BOGOPA JEROME INC. PROJECT SUMMARY Bogopa Jerome Inc. seeks financial assistance for a facility located at 1941-1959 Jerome Avenue, Bronx, New York 10453. Total Project Cost: $18,000,000. Actions Requested.
PROJECT NUMBERS - 11513, 11676 INDUSTRIAL PROGRAM PROPOSAL MGN 24-53 49TH STREET, LLC & MGN 150 LIBERTY, LLC PROJECT SUMMARY The companies seek financial assistance for facilities located at 24-53 49th Street, Astoria, New York 11103. Total Project Cost: $13,944,348. Actions Requested.
INDUSTRIAL PROGRAM PROPOSAL OUTBACK 1, LLC & SUNNYSIDE 1, LLC PROJECT SUMMARY The companies seek assistance for a facility located at 42-36 Northern Boulevard, Long Island City, New York 11101. Total Project Cost: $45,000,000. Actions Requested.

documents.text:
MINUTES OF THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF BUILD NYC RESOURCE CORPORATION MARCH 24, 2026
5. AECI 2970 Third Avenue, LLC
The project was presented for bond approval. A motion to approve the resolution was made, seconded and unanimously approved.
6. Brooklyn Friends School
The project was presented for bond approval. A motion to approve the resolution for Brooklyn Friends School was made, seconded and unanimously approved.
7. Adjournment
FINANCING PROPOSAL BROOKLYN FRIENDS SCHOOL PROJECT SUMMARY Brooklyn Friends School seeks financing for facilities located at 383-393 Pearl Street a/k/a 19-23 Willoughby Street, Brooklyn, New York 11201. Financing Amount: $34,000,000. Total Project Cost: $34,000,000. Actions Requested. Project Number - 11675.

MINUTES OF THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF NEW YORK CITY INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AGENCY MAY 19, 2026
11. F&F Hardware & Supply, Inc.
The project was presented for review. A motion to approve the inducement and authorizing resolution for F&F Hardware & Supply, Inc. was made, seconded and unanimously approved.
12. Granville Stores Corp. and Granville Payne Retail LLC
The project was presented for review. A motion to approve the inducement and authorizing resolution for Granville Stores Corp. and Granville Payne Retail LLC was made, seconded and unanimously approved.
13. Adjournment
PROJECT NUMBER - 11734 INDUSTRIAL PROGRAM PROPOSAL F&F HARDWARE & SUPPLY, INC. PROJECT SUMMARY The company seeks financial assistance for a facility located at 1275 Oak Point Avenue, Bronx, New York 10474. Total Project Cost: $25,137,585. Actions Requested.
PROJECT NUMBER - 11595 FRESH PROGRAM PROPOSAL GRANVILLE STORES CORP. AND GRANVILLE PAYNE RETAIL LLC PROJECT SUMMARY The companies seek financial assistance for a facility located at 340 Pennsylvania Avenue a/k/a 626 Sutter Avenue, Brooklyn, New York 11207. Total Project Cost: $3,077,500. Actions Requested.
